title: New York Botanical Plein Air Event
content: I'll be painting today at theNew York Botanical Garden, along with about 20 of my friends. Come on by and say a quick hello.Gurney at NYBG. Photo by Ben HiderThis isn't a workshop or demo, but it will be fun to see a bunch of artists painting in the gardens.Two paintings from a previous sessionare available in an Artsy auctionthat closes in two days.
